thirdPersonNote.name: Test User
thirdPersonNote.note: Shares _parent=dbEntity with the 2 expected OAuth persons, but has NO entu_user property at all (email/provider both null). createUserForAccount (routes/auth/index.get.js) ALWAYS sets entu_user as part of the same create call -- a person with this _parent but no entu_user almost certainly did NOT come through the OAuth auto-provision path. Per team scratchpad (perotin.md session 9, Phase D), 'Test User' is a known long-standing test fixture (name-restore work, formula-unwrap sanity checks) predating the add_user reversibility-tracked work (session 37). [speculative] Its _parent match is likely a manual/seed-time choice, not add_user-mediated -- not independently re-confirmed against creation history in this probe.
